Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Smooth flow - No glugging!
Excellent product. Holds a good amount of water. I liked that it actually has 2 handles one of which is not visible in the advertised pictures. The synthetic flexible carrying loop is good to hold and won’t touch the ground even for shorter people. The harder plastic handle locks in to the lid and can be flipped out for carrying. It is much broader than other smaller titan bottles I have and feels more comfortable to hold. I bought 2 bottles. The clear pink has motivational messages and time markers. The Capacity clear bottle just has ounces and ml marked on the side. It fits in the coffee cup holders of both sedans and SUVs without the cup liners. The best part of these bottles is the fantastic smooth flow of the water without glugging or flowing in spurts. This is due to the small vent hole that allows air to escape, preventing vacuum formation when drinking. It works best when you drink from the opposite side of the vent, not from the sides or perpendicular to the vent. As with any water bottle, once in a while, I use a bottle bright cleaning tablet to clean it and avoid mold. I love these bottles.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Best water bottle ever!
    Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2026
    Color: Smoke GreySize: 32 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This bottle hits all of the criteria for greatness. It is BPA-free, I can see through it to see how much water I drank, it is labeled clearly and with big writing to indicate how much water is left and where I should be time-wise in having drank water for the day. Like most water bottles, it has a flip top dust cover and it is easily lockable so no water spills out. Unlike some water bottles, it has an extra hole at the top under the dust cover that lets out air so that you don't drink a bunch of air with your water. Unlike most water bottles, it has two handy ways to hold the bottle. It has both a hard loop on top for folk like me who hold the bottle with one finger (that makes it easy to set the bottle down, unlike with the cloth strap that it also provides which otherwise can be a nice way to carry it too. It easily fits into any car or standard cupholder. It is dishwasher friendly (though make sure the strap is captured on the bottom level of the dishwasher (like looping it around a fork) so that it doesn't get burned. If you're wondering about glass bottles, I've bought them too, but these are lighter, a bit shorter, and you don't have to worry about breaking them if you drop them. Also, the glass water bottles don't tend to have all of the features described above. Last, I like that it offers multiple colors, as in drinking my 64 oz/day, I use one color to signify my first bottle and the other to signify my second because I used to forget if I'd had one or two bottles in any given day. In short, I have bought many water bottles, and this is the best of them all! It's also cheap - well priced for the value.

    Awesome affordable water bottle with cool features!
    Reviewed in the United States on May 6, 2026
    Color: A-ClearSize: 32 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Awesome water bottle! Here are the features I love:

    -Skinny, so it fits in my car's cup holder and it's easy to grip.

    -Has a filter piece to keep ice (or lemons, limes, tea bags, etc.) from getting through.

    -Has an easy to open lid (lockable to prevent leaks) with a drinking spout (perfect amount of water comes through to drink).

    -Has a carrying handle that I can put around my wrist which makes the water bottle very portable.

    -I bought the clear version and it looks great.

    -Has fl oz and ml on one side, and has time indicators (and encouraging phrases) for reminders to drink on the other side -- really helps with hydration!

    -I purchased it for $9.99 which is very affordable.

    One thing to keep in mind:

    -Not dishwasher safe -- hand wash only with a scrubbing brush.

    This water bottle has made hydration more convenient and fun for me. I highly recommend it!

    5 out of 5 stars
    Smooth flow - No glugging!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2026
    Color: Capacity ClearSize: 32 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Excellent product. Holds a good amount of water. I liked that it actually has 2 handles one of which is not visible in the advertised pictures. The synthetic flexible carrying loop is good to hold and won’t touch the ground even for shorter people. The harder plastic handle locks in to the lid and can be flipped out for carrying. It is much broader than other smaller titan bottles I have and feels more comfortable to hold.

    I bought 2 bottles. The clear pink has motivational messages and time markers. The Capacity clear bottle just has ounces and ml marked on the side. It fits in the coffee cup holders of both sedans and SUVs without the cup liners.

    The best part of these bottles is the fantastic smooth flow of the water without glugging or flowing in spurts. This is due to the small vent hole that allows air to escape, preventing vacuum formation when drinking. It works best when you drink from the opposite side of the vent, not from the sides or perpendicular to the vent.

    As with any water bottle, once in a while, I use a bottle bright cleaning tablet to clean it and avoid mold. I love these bottles.

Product Description

Oldley water bottles are made from Tritan premium edible material for a safe and enjoyable drinking experience. Tritan is a premium copolyester plastic that's completely BPA-free, ensuring this sports water bottle won't create lingering odors, harmful chemicals, or unpleasant tastes. The flip cover adopts a safety lock to prevent dust and leakage. The frosted texture of the water bottle allows you to hold it better. This is a safe choice for people of all ages.
